In the background, the wooden tray with breakfast items and the street view are visible through the glass. Power lines crisscross the frame, and a person on a scooter passes by the ground floor. (18) The final shot shows the glass sliding doors of the hotel entrance. Above the doors, a large green sign reads "PRINCE SMART INN HAKATA," with text at the bottom prompting viewers to click for more information.
